endpoint.note: paramDef から params を生成（upstream と同じ形）
endpoint.noteEn: Generates params from paramDef (the same shape as upstream)

endpoints.note: upstream の endpoint-list と同じ順序
endpoints.noteEn: The same order as upstream's endpoint-list

export-custom-emojis.note: ExportCustomEmojisProcessorService 相当（mk-jobs、zip をドライブへ保存し exportCompleted 通知）
export-custom-emojis.noteEn: Equivalent to ExportCustomEmojisProcessorService (mk-jobs; saves the zip to the drive and sends an exportCompleted notification)

fetch-rss.note: 同時実行上限（32）と同一 URL の合流は isolate 単位
fetch-rss.noteEn: The concurrency limit (32) and coalescing of the same URL are per isolate
fetch-rss.summary: 同時実行上限は isolate 単位
fetch-rss.summaryEn: The concurrency limit is per isolate

get-avatar-decorations.note: ロール id は存在するロール（未ログイン時は公開ロール）に限定
get-avatar-decorations.noteEn: Role ids are limited to roles that exist (public roles when not logged in)

get-online-users-count.note: lastActiveDate が 10 分以内のユーザー数
get-online-users-count.noteEn: The number of users whose lastActiveDate is within 10 minutes

meta.note: MetaEntityService.pack / packDetailed 相当。NULL の列は upstream と同じく null を返す。repositoryUrl が NULL のときだけ、AGPL §13 のソース提供のためにこのフォークの URL を返す（packages/api/src/meta-defaults.ts）
meta.noteEn: Equivalent to MetaEntityService.pack / packDetailed. NULL columns are returned as null, as upstream does. Only a NULL repositoryUrl falls back to this fork's URL, to offer the source under AGPL §13 (packages/api/src/meta-defaults.ts)
meta.summary: repositoryUrl が未設定のときはフォークの URL を返す
meta.summaryEn: Returns this fork's URL when repositoryUrl is unset

pinned-users.note: Acct.parse したアカウントを凍結の有無にかかわらず解決（upstream 同様）
pinned-users.noteEn: Resolves the account from Acct.parse regardless of whether it is suspended (the same as upstream)

reset-db.note: NODE_ENV=test 以外として常に INTERNAL_ERROR
reset-db.noteEn: Always INTERNAL_ERROR, as if it were not NODE_ENV=test

retention.noteEn: Aggregation is done by cron (equivalent to AggregateRetentionProcessorService)

server-info.note: Worker にはマシン情報がないため、常に enableServerMachineStats 無効時の固定値を返す
server-info.noteEn: A Worker has no machine information, so it always returns the fixed values used when enableServerMachineStats is disabled

stats.note: notesCount / usersCount はチャートの total ではなく現存行数、reactionsCount / instances は行数（upstream は 1 時間キャッシュ付き count）
stats.noteEn: notesCount / usersCount are the number of existing rows, not the chart total; reactionsCount / instances are row counts (upstream is a count with a 1-hour cache)

test.note: 検証済みパラメータ（既定値・i を含む）をそのまま返す
test.noteEn: Returns the validated parameters (including defaults and i) as-is
